Hi Bonnie — thanks for the note and the attachments. Attaching an MSA redline (PDF) with suggested edits; below is the quick summary of what we propose so you can proceed with comms scheduling: 

- Reference & Logo: Redwood can be listed as a vendor/customer reference. Logo usage is allowed for case study/partner pages and joint announcements only; logos must be used from the official assets provided (no modifications) and with the attribution line: "Redwood Inference — Inference Platform". No use in paid ads.
- Quotes/Testimonials: No customer quote may be published without prior written consent; consent cannot be unreasonably withheld.
- Press Releases / Embargo: Mutual review of release text is required. We propose a 3-business-day review window prior to publication; neither party may unreasonably delay.
- Confidentiality carve-out: A limited carve-out for announcement-related information (release text, logo use, announcement date) is permitted, but detailed technical or usage data remains confidential.

If that suits, we can incorporate these redlines into the MSA/order form and send a DocuSign envelope for sign-off. Attaching: BrightSys_MSA_redline_20260504.pdf

Next step: If you confirm the 3-business-day window and the logo constraints, I'll loop in legal (Karthik) for final language and ship the DocuSign.

Best,

Hi all — suggested consolidated clause below (proposed final language to insert into MSA/order form):

"Publicity and References. Either party may publicly announce the existence of the business relationship. Prior to any public announcement or press release referencing the other party, the announcing party shall provide the other party with a draft of the announcement and a reasonable period of not less than three (3) business days to review and approve the announcement. Approval shall not be unreasonably withheld. The Customer may use the Company’s trademarks and logos solely in connection with the announcement and on the Customer’s partner page, provided that (i) the Customer obtains the Company’s prior written approval of the logo artwork and the release text, (ii) the Customer uses only Company-provided asset files, and (iii) the Customer does not use Company trademarks in paid advertisements or in a manner that suggests endorsement of third-party products. Customer quotes require prior written approval, which shall not be unreasonably withheld.

This language aligns with our standard and preserves the confidentiality carve-outs for announcement-level materials only."

I've also created the updated Order Form in our system and started a DocuSign envelope; link below. Unless there are objections, I'll push the DocuSign today.
